title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
locator: Self-assess your content; Who, How, and Why; Why was the content created?
appraisal: Primary search-provider guidance, not an independent effect-size study. Supports originality, sourcing and transparent authorship; does not validate this journal workflow.

title: SEO Starter Guide
locator: How long until I see impact; Help Google find your content; Things you should not focus on
appraisal: Primary operational guidance. No promised rankings, word-count target or requirement to narrow the journal to a single niche.

title: Influencing title links in search results
locator: Best practices for influencing title links, especially descriptive and concise text and branding
appraisal: Titles influence Google preferences; actual displayed titles are selected automatically. No fixed character limit.

title: How to write meta descriptions
locator: Best practices for creating quality meta descriptions; Create unique descriptions for each page
appraisal: Google sometimes uses the description. A proposed snippet is not guaranteed display or a demonstrated ranking improvement.

title: SEO link best practices
locator: Make your links crawlable; Internal links: cross-reference your own content; External links
appraisal: Supports crawlable links and contextual internal navigation. Does not prescribe a link quota.

title: Build and submit a sitemap
locator: Sitemap best practices; Additional notes about XML sitemaps; Submit your sitemap to Google
appraisal: Sitemap submission is a hint, not a guarantee of indexing. Supports preferred URLs and accurate significant-update dates.

title: Article structured data
locator: How to add structured data; Article objects; author.url, dateModified, datePublished
appraisal: Supports accurate applicable article metadata and validation. No required Article properties; markup is not a prerequisite for ordinary search visibility.

title: About Search Console
locator: About Search Console, tools and reports list
appraisal: Documents available reports. Does not establish whether the owner already has a verified property.

title: Performance report: Search results
locator: Choosing metrics; Choosing dimensions; Reading the chart and table; Sharing and exporting data
appraisal: Primary metric definitions. Differences in period, query mix, position and aggregation prevent simple causal claims.

title: Understanding Core Web Vitals and Google search results
locator: Core Web Vitals metrics; Optimizing your Core Web Vitals
appraisal: Explains real-world loading, responsiveness and stability metrics. No performance measurements were run in this audit.
